title: CMS, Dynamic Story and Brand Interaction evidence seam
summary: CMS Brand Builder references and Dynamic Story decisions are carried as context, while social communication retains conversation/receipt evidence suitable for later Brand Interaction evaluation.
invariants: Do not infer a brand intention from published text if upstream intention/structured utterance evidence exists.
The social library must not synthesize approved claims, brand policy, consumer consent or personal identity.
A positive platform reaction is a raw observation, not proof of commercial effect or causality.
Projection to Brand Interaction Effect/Journey must keep provenance and disclosure controls; owner implementation remains separate.

provenance.claim: Publication records carry upstream intention references

cross_sphere_reference.note: Brand Interaction Stack owns later evidence interpretation, cohort statistics, intervention governance and Institution Policy seam. No source/vendor permission is inherited.
